en.answer: If <<11927>> is Tribute Summoned to your side of the field, or even your opponent's side of the field, the Summon can be negated by <<4861>>.
en.question: If I am Tribute Summoning <<11927>> to my side of the field, can the Tribute Summon be negated by <<4861>>? Also, if I am Tribute Summoning <<11927>> to my opponent's side of the field, can the Tribute Summon be negated by <<4861>>?
